content:
Nora H: opened PR #4922 to update release notes + changelog entry for the model catalog deprecation and add a short migration snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4922

Diego Ramos: assigning myself for tech review and will do a quick pass on the migration snippet. Ops requested a single-line changelog for the release notes.

CI Bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-4922--redwood-docs.netlify.app — Status: failed
Logs: Broken link: docs/sdk/python.md#examples -> 404

Nora H: I think the anchor changed during last refactor. I'll fix the anchor and add both Python + curl minimal examples.

Kira O'Neill: please include a short migration caveat about differences in default tokenization for old prompts. Suggest adding a one-liner for rollback plan too.

Nora H: adding snippets now. Python example: "from redwood import Client\nclient=Client(api_key=...); r=client.text.generate(model='redwood/core-std', input='Summarize Q1'); print(r.output_text)"
Curl example for ops added as a one-liner. Also added rollback note: keep old model id in config for quick revert.

DocsBot: label 'release-note-required' added; label 'docs-review' added.

CI Bot: New build (commit a1b2c3) -> Preview success ✅

Diego Ramos: quick tech note approved. Left one tiny comment about batching example but not blocking.

Nora H: pushed addressed comment. Requesting final approval for merge. Target merge time: 07:40 PT tomorrow so infra has 30m for smoke tests. If CI flakes we will require two reviewer approvals for manual merge.

Diego Ramos: +1, LGTM.

Kira O'Neill: LGTM from docs side.

CI Bot: Merge checks passed.

Nora H: merging at scheduled time. Will follow up in release notes channel after smoke tests. Thanks!
